t: How the Citation Network Analyzer works (Signature)
title: How the Citation Network Analyzer works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Citation Network Analyzer does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach builds the citation graph deterministically: fixed parsing rules, fixed resolution thresholds, fixed PageRank parameters — the same corpus always yields the same influence map. Each edge stores its source citation text, and each score carries the graph version it was computed on. Re-running on unchanged data reproduces identical rankings. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
